title: 第99章 文道要兴传承要续第98章 以文化道方为天下
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
众人不知道的是，天道对这四句话是真的产生的共鸣，但当天道感知道说这四句话的人是姬云天的时候，当场就来了句：“我热烈的马。”就想直接劈死姬云天这个天选逆子。这个王八蛋一次次地挑衅他的尊严。他怎么能不怒？
就在天道雷劫即将落下之时，姬云天对着天空看了一会，他抬手一挥，整座轩辕学院升起一层淡青色的屏障，轻声道：“这是文道盛会，天道老爷也该给文道留几分颜面，这雷，不能劈在我文道大赛的场地上。”淡青色气雾直冲云霄，竟硬生生将欲落的劫云挡在了学院之外，天空中雷声越发沉闷，却始终没能落下半道雷弧。
姬云天握着剑柄负手而立，抬头对着云层朗声笑道：“怎么，只许你定规则，不许我说人话？我今天把话放在这，文道要兴，传承要续，你拦不住的。大家给对方留下一些颜面，这个人情我记下了。”
云层又轰鸣了许久，最终才气鼓鼓地翻卷着退去，天空重新恢复澄澈，只留一丝残留的威压弥漫在天地间，让所有人都惊出了一身冷汗。
等到众人回过神来，才发现刚才那些陷入顿悟的修士，此刻周身都萦绕着淡淡的文气，修为境界竟都有了不同程度的增长，当即有人对着看台躬身一拜，高声道：“谢姬族长传道！”这一声喊出，全场近百名参赛者，连同周围围观的各宗修士，全都齐齐躬身行礼，声浪震得古柏落叶沙沙作响。
金宸笑着对姬云天道：“话你已经说了，名你已经留了，接下来该该让年轻人上场了。”姬云天点头。
没等姬云天说话，姬飞雪已经拿着玉简走上前，侧身抬手，朗声宣布：“苍天文道诗词大赛，开始！”
此次大赛分三轮，第一轮以“问天”为题，限一个时辰作出诗词，由七位文道前辈评审选出前三十，在开始之前，由老毕登做的样板诗词被拿出来做了样稿。样稿一出，举座哗然，不哗然是不可能的，老毕登剽窃了苏轼大文豪的词作。当然是改了几个字，用来应苍天的景的。
《水调歌头·问天》
明月几时有，把酒问苍天。
不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。
我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒。
起舞弄清影，何似在人间！
转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠。
不应有恨，何事长向别时圆？
人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。
但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
这首词可以说是蓝星霸榜千年的诗词佳作，从艺术成就上看，此篇属于苏词代表作之一。它构思奇拔，畦径独辟，极富浪漫主义色彩。立意高远，构思新颖，意境清新如画。最后以旷达情怀收束，是词人情怀的自然流露。情韵兼胜，境界壮美，具有很高的审美价值。此词全篇皆是佳句，典型地体现出苏大文豪词作的清雄旷达的风格。
有了毕雷诗作的样板，下座参赛人等，一个个先是激动，接着就开始抓耳挠腮起来。他们看到毕雷的词无不叫好，想到自己马上又自惭形秽，心情大起大落的太快，着实刺激了。
毕竟有珠玉在前，寻常作品哪里还入得了眼，不少人本就对文道理解不深，此刻拿着笔迟迟落不下去，指尖都攥出了汗。一个时辰说长不长，砚中的松烟墨磨了又磨，白玉案上的宣纸依旧大片空白，看得看台之上的围观修士也跟着心焦。

也有天资高妙之辈，稍作沉吟便挥笔泼墨，不过大半炷香就写完收笔，安坐蒲团上闭目养神，静待时辰耗尽。姬云天坐在主位上，用神念扫过一张张诗作，见其中也不乏意境不俗的作品，不由得微微点头，文道沉寂这么久，终究还是有不少人在默默坚守。
时辰一到，评审席上的七位文道前辈便起身收卷，逐篇评点，不消半个时辰，前三十名的名单就已经确定，姬飞雪拿着玉简朗声念出姓名，入选者脸上皆是欣喜，落选者虽有失落，却也并未沮丧，只纷纷对着姬云天的方向拱手，称此行收获颇丰，不枉来这一趟。
对于大多数文道修士来说，他们修行本就没有前路，全靠自己摸索，今天能够来参与此次盛会，就已经是不可多得的机会了。
姬云天他细观察下方的参赛者，竟然从中发现有自己的孩子也在其中，入得前三十名，只是他有点记不清孩子是谁生的，但是自己的种还是可以一眼定血脉的。这让他有些欣欣然。
接下来的第二轮，以“问道”为题，限半个时辰，再选前十进入最终对台。这一轮比第一轮更见功底，毕竟问道，既要有传承，也要有发展，还要见性情，最见文道修士的心胸与感悟，不少修士提笔就写下了对祖上传承的敬慕，也有人写出了文道衰微的慨叹，更有人写出了继往开来的志向。
content_en:
What everyone didn't know was that Tiandao really resonated with these four sentences, but when Tiandao knew that the person who said these four sentences was Ji Yuntian, he said on the spot: "My passionate horse." He wanted to kill Ji Yuntian, the chosen traitor. This bastard challenged his dignity again and again. How could he not be angry?
Just when the thunder calamity of Tiandao was about to fall, Ji Yuntian looked at the sky for a while. He raised his hand and waved, and the entire Xuanyuan Academy rose up with a light blue barrier. He said softly: "This is a grand gathering of literature and art. Lord Tiandao should leave some space for literature and education." Face-to-face, this thunder cannot hit the venue of our Literary Arts Competition." The light green mist shot straight into the sky, blocking the falling calamity clouds from the academy. The thunder in the sky became duller, but it still failed to land even half of the thunder arc.
Ji Yuntian stood holding the hilt of the sword with his hands behind his back, raised his head and laughed loudly at the clouds: "Why, you are only allowed to set the rules, and I am not allowed to speak human words? I will put my words here today. The culture must be prosperous and the inheritance must be continued. You can't stop it. Let's leave some face to each other. I will remember this favor."
The clouds roared for a long time, and finally rolled away with great force, and the sky became clear again, leaving only a trace of residual pressure permeating the sky and earth, making everyone break out in a cold sweat.
When everyone came back to their senses, they discovered that the monks who had just fallen into enlightenment were now surrounded by a faint literary spirit, and their cultivation realms had increased to varying degrees. Someone immediately bowed to the stands and shouted: "Clan Chief Xie Ji preaches!" With this shout, nearly a hundred contestants in the audience, as well as the monks from various sects watching around, all bowed and saluted, and the sound shook the fallen leaves of ancient cypress trees to rustle.
Jin Chen smiled and said to Ji Yuntian: "You have said your words, and you have reserved your name. Now it is time for the young people to take the stage." Ji Yuntian nodded.
Before Ji Yuntian could speak, Ji Feixue had already stepped forward with the jade slip, raised her hand sideways, and announced loudly: "The Cangtian Literary Poetry Competition begins!"
The competition was divided into three rounds. In the first round, with the theme of "Asking the Heaven", people were limited to one hour to compose poems. The top 30 poems were selected by seven literary seniors. Before starting, the sample poems written by Old Biden were taken out as a sample. As soon as the sample manuscript came out, everyone was in an uproar. It was impossible not to be in an uproar. Old Biden plagiarized the lyrics of the great writer Su Shi. Of course, a few words were changed to match the scenery of the sky.
"Shui Tiao Ge Tou·Ask the Sky"
When will the bright moon come? Ask the sky for wine.
I don’t know what year it is today in the palace in the sky.
I want to ride the wind back home, but I'm afraid it's too cold in the high places.
Dance and clear the shadow, how does it seem to be in the human world!
Turn to the Zhu Pavilion, look down at the Qihu, and the light will make you sleepless.
There should be no hatred, why should we be reunited when we say goodbye?
People have joys and sorrows, separations and reunions, and the moon waxes and wanes. This is a difficult thing in ancient times.
I hope that people will live long and share the beauty of the moon thousands of miles apart.
This poem can be said to be Blue Star's masterpiece of poetry that has dominated the list for thousands of years. From the perspective of artistic achievements, this poem is one of Su's representative works. It has a fantastic conception, a unique border path, and is full of romanticism. The intention is high, the concept is novel, and the artistic conception is fresh and picturesque. Finally, it ends with broad-minded feelings, which is a natural expression of the poet's feelings. It has both emotional charm and magnificent state, and has high aesthetic value. This poem is full of beautiful sentences, which typically reflects the Qingxiong and broad-minded style of Su Da writer's poems.
With the sample of Bi Lei's poem, the next contestants were excited at first, and then started to scratch their heads. They all applauded when they saw Bi Lei's words, and it was really irritating to think that they were immediately ashamed of themselves, and their moods fluctuated so quickly.
After all, there are pearls and jade in front of them, and ordinary works are not attractive to the eyes. Many people do not have a deep understanding of literature. At this moment, they can't put down the pen, and their fingertips are sweating. An hour is not long. The pine smoke ink in the inkstone was polished again and again. The rice paper on the white jade table was still blank. The monks on the stand were also anxious..
There are also talented people who meditate for a moment before swiping their pen and ink, but after finishing most of the incense sticks, they stop writing, sit on the futon, close their eyes and rest, waiting for the time to run out. Ji Yuntian sat on the main seat and scanned the poems with his spiritual mind. Seeing that there were also works with good artistic conception among them, he couldn't help but nodded slightly. Literary education had been silent for so long, but after all, there were still many people who persisted silently.
As soon as the time came, the seven literary seniors at the judging table stood up to collect their papers and commented on each article one by one. In less than half an hour, the list of the top 30 had been determined. Ji Feixue took the jade slip and read out their names aloud. The faces of those who were selected were all happy. Although those who were not selected were disappointed, they were not depressed. They just handed over in the direction of Ji Yuntian, saying that the trip was fruitful and worthwhile.
For most literary monks, they have no way forward in their practice and rely entirely on their own exploration. Being able to participate in this event today is a rare opportunity.
Ji Yuntian carefully observed the contestants below and discovered that his own child was among them and ranked among the top thirty. However, he couldn't remember who gave birth to the child, but he could still determine his bloodline at a glance. This made him somewhat pleased.
The next second round, with the theme of "Asking", is limited to half an hour, and the top ten will be selected to enter the final stage. This round is more important than the first round. After all, asking questions requires both inheritance and development, as well as temperament. The most important thing is the broad-mindedness and understanding of the literary monks. Many monks wrote down their admiration for the inheritance of their ancestors, while others lamented the decline of the literary world, and some even wrote about their ambition to carry on the past and forge ahead into the future.
